NFL DFS Projections Week 4: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 4 · 12 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 2, 5:44 PM ET

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 4 DraftKings main slate: 21.9 DraftKings points at $7,700. He holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations. Chase Brown holds the largest share at 30% for $6,100.

Behind Allen, the model's next four projections are Jaxon Smith-Njigba (20.4, $9,100), Lamar Jackson (20.2, $7,300), Derrick Henry (20.0, $8,400) and Christian McCaffrey (19.8, $7,700). Josh Allen returns the most per dollar of that group at 2.85 projected points per $1,000. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the wide receivers at 20.4 for $9,100, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 21.9 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 17.7 for $6,500.

The 12-game slate runs from a 51.5-point total in JAX at CIN down to 38.5 in MIA at MIN. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 2, 5:44 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 4 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs NE ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.9 DraftKings points at $7,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.7 points clear of Lamar Jackson. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.85 projected points per $1,000, 16th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 40.2, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against New England, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Lamar Jackson, BAL vs TEN ($7,300)

Lamar Jackson projects 2nd at the position with 20.2 DraftKings points at $7,300, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model includes 4.5 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.77 projected points per $1,000, 20th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Jackson averaged 20.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 37.1, and he holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is an 11.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 27 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Jalon Daniels, TB vs GB ($4,400)

Jalon Daniels projects for 16.4 DraftKings points at $4,400, which works out to 3.72 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 22 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.7 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 29.7, and he holds 2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tampa Bay is a 3.5-point underdog at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 39.5.
